name: round-1983
title: Fix round #1983 — six items landed on main (2026-10-10): both P1s, crossed and restated rings

cases.title: Analytic: on a concave quadrilateral the diagonals' meeting point O is drawn, with the diagonal extended dashed out to it
cases.lookFor: O drawn at (2,2) outside the shape; diagonals AC and BD solid; AC continues DASHED from C out to O
cases.before: The line was accepted green and O was never drawn

cases.title: Analytic: the «מפגש» spelling draws the same figure
cases.lookFor: Accepted. Identical to T1: O at (2,2), both diagonals solid, AC extended dashed from C to O
cases.before: Refused as «does not exist»

cases.title: Analytic: inside a convex quadrilateral the «מפגש» spelling still marks the point only (regression guard)
cases.lookFor: O at (2,2) inside the square; NO diagonals and NO dashed line
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: 2-D: a trapezoid's height whose foot lands beyond the top side gets that side extended, dashed
cases.lookFor: Whenever E lands beyond D (or C), side DC continues DASHED out to E; when E lands on DC, no dashed line. Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» to see both
cases.before: E floated beside the shape with nothing joining it to DC

cases.title: Analytic: the same for a trapezoid given by coordinates
cases.lookFor: E at (0,3); a dashed stretch from D(1,3) to E
cases.before: E floated at (0,3) with nothing joining it

cases.title: REFUSAL — 2-D: a quadrilateral in a crossing order over a square's points, with the new wording
cases.lookFor: The second line is refused; the message ends «…או לשנות את מקומות הנקודות — …»
cases.before: The same refusal, ending «…או לשנות את השיעורים…»

cases.title: 2-D: a kite plus a second ring in another order is drawn as a dart, not refused
cases.lookFor: Both lines accepted; the kite is drawn as a dart (concave) and neither ABCD nor ABDC crosses itself
cases.before: The second line was refused with the crossed-ring message

cases.title: REFUSAL — 3-D: the same crossing order over a square is refused
cases.lookFor: «מרובע ACBD» is refused with the same ring message as 2-D
cases.before: Accepted green, drawn crossed

cases.title: Analytic: a trapezoid with a free letter k is drawn as a real trapezoid
cases.lookFor: A real (uncrossed) trapezoid with A to the right of B (k > 4); «הציגו תצורה אחרת» still moves k
cases.before: A crossed bow-tie, drawn green

cases.title: REFUSAL — 3-D: a square re-declared as a parallelogram in a crossing order
cases.lookFor: The second line is refused (the parallelogram claim fails on ACBD). Judge the wording: it is the existing check-the-calculation refusal, not the crossed-ring message
cases.before: Accepted with a false «a square is already a parallelogram»

cases.title: 2-D: an inscribed octagon is never drawn self-crossing
cases.lookFor: On every press of «הציגו תצורה אחרת» the octagon's sides never cross, and the shape changes
cases.before: About one press in four drew it self-crossing

cases.title: 2-D: a pentagon stated concave stays concave and never crosses (regression guard)
cases.lookFor: Concave on every press, never self-crossing
cases.before: unchanged

cases.title: 2-D: a square restated with its letters reversed adds no row
cases.lookFor: «זה כבר קיים באיור — אין מה להוסיף.» and still ONE row
cases.before: A second row with no note

cases.title: 2-D: the same square started from another corner
cases.lookFor: The same note and one row
cases.before: Refused with the internal «'D' is already defined…»

cases.title: 3-D: the reversed restatement gets 3-D's own note
cases.lookFor: «הנתון הזה כבר נאמר («ריבוע ABCD») — הציור לא השתנה ולא נוספה שורה» and one row
cases.before: A second row with no note

cases.title: Analytic: a triangle restated in another order
cases.lookFor: «זה כבר ידוע מהנתונים שכתבתם…» and one row
cases.before: A second row

cases.title: REFUSAL — 3-D: a quadrilateral on a cube's non-flat corners says it must be flat
cases.lookFor: «מרובע הוא צורה שטוחה, והקודקודים A, B, C, A' אינם נמצאים במישור אחד — ולכן «מרובע ABCA'» לא מתקיים יחד עם «קובייה ABCDA'B'C'D'».»; the cube stays drawn
cases.before: «הנתונים סותרים זה את זה — אין גוף שמקיים…»

cases.title: REFUSAL — 3-D: a pentagon is named a pentagon in that message
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused with «מחומש הוא צורה שטוחה…» — never «מרובע»
cases.before: The generic «הנתונים סותרים זה את זה…»

cases.title: REFUSAL — Analytic: a parallelogram is not called a trapezoid
cases.lookFor: «הצורה כבר ידועה כ־מקבילית — ולכן אינה נקראת טרפז. מחקו את הנתון הקודם אם התכוונתם טרפז.»
cases.before: «already known» — a parallelogram treated as a trapezoid

cases.title: REFUSAL — Analytic: a rectangle is not an isosceles trapezoid
cases.lookFor: Refused, naming מלבן and טרפז שווה שוקיים
cases.before: Accepted, drawing a rectangle with no warning

cases.title: Analytic: a trapezoid made a parallelogram by its sides keeps the amber warning (regression guard)
cases.lookFor: All three lines are recorded and the amber «no longer a trapezoid» warning still appears
cases.before: unchanged
